findings.title: DIRECTIVE-20260613-001 (prune-integrity silent-push gap) was zombie-pending ~22 days after its deliverable landed
findings.evidence: Directive created 2026-06-13, status:pending. Its deliverable — a propose-only PROP investigating the prune push gap — was authored as PROP-107 on 2026-06-19 (PROP-107.directive === 'DIRECTIVE-20260613-001'). Auto-close (PROP-108, enforce) never caught it because: (a) the directive lacks the auto_close_when_deliverable_proposed opt-in added by PROP-120; (b) PROP-107 uses field name 'directive' rather than the 'directive_id'/'source_directive' that directive-auto-close.js reads for forward back-refs; (c) PROP-107 status is 'pending', not 'proposed' (PROP-120's opt-in treats 'proposed' as terminal-for-directive, not 'pending'). Zombie-pending directives re-preempt the tinker dispatcher every run, starving other work.
findings.resolution: Closed manually via clone-write+push (additive-edit per CLAUDE.md DIRECTIVE-LIFECYCLE exception: status pending->completed + completed_at + completed_by_run + prop_id_authored=PROP-107 + closure_note). Matches the PROP-120 interim-manual-flip pattern used for the -0628 batch.

Track PROP-107 on the normal PROP-review radar.
